（印：C.I.S. No 115 Date 8/6/26）

SIN WAN PAO - JUNE 6, 1926.

Correspondence.

Your paper has published a report, supplied by
the Da Hwa News Agency, to the effect that the "Independent
Youth" Magazine Society had been raided on suspicions of
propagating Bolshevism, that over 10,000 copies of its
magazines were seized and that a member of the society
named Wong Kong (黃剛) has been sentenced to two years'
imprisonment in connection with this offence. This
news is entirely contradictory to facts. Magazines
published by our society have always been those advocating
an anti-Bolshevik policy. Although Mr. Wong, a member of
our society, was arrested through a misunderstanding by
detectives of the Shanghai-Woosung Constabulary, he was
subsequently released after having been questioned by the
Magistrate of the Shanghai-Woosung Constabulary who was
satisfied that there was no evidence to show that our
society has propagated Bolshevism. As regards the confisca-
tion of the society's magazines, this is also untrue.
The report supplied by the Da Hwa News Agency is obviously
based on unfounded information. We therefore would ask
you to publish this refutation.

The Independent Youth Magazine Society.

（印：C.I.S. 第 115 号 日期 26年6月8日）

《新闻报》 - 1926年6月6日。

通信。

贵报刊登了一则由大华通讯社提供的报道，称“独立青年”杂志社因涉嫌宣传布尔什维克主义而遭到搜查，其杂志一万多册被没收，且该社一名名为黄刚（Wong Kong）的成员因此罪被判两年监禁。此消息与事实完全相悖。本社出版的杂志一贯主张反布尔什维克政策。虽然本社成员黄先生因上海吴淞警察局的侦探误解而被捕，但在经上海吴淞警察局推事讯问后，因确信并无证据表明本社宣传布尔什维克主义，随后将其释放。至于没收本社杂志一事，亦属不实。大华通讯社提供的报道显然基于毫无根据的消息。因此，我们恳请贵报刊登此辟谣声明。

独立青年杂志社。

（批：例行公事）
（批：抄送政治部）
（批：Ennis）
（批：副本已于26年6月7日发送 HR）

Sin Wan Pao - June 6, 1926.

來函
查化緣大德道氣莊清立有青年釋道社因有宣傳奉化維
新教義對內佈置職務並囑社員黃鵬刊處徒刑二年云云
此等消息完全與事實不符本社前呈之刊物本持反對共產主
義及無政府主義者其五月二十日所載新聞係由社員拘去經
警署審訊後釋放以本社並無違背法律事實即行釋放對於
本社名譽大有損害大德道氣莊清及社員等消極抗議損失
實難更正特此函請貴報登報更正以昭信守而維法紀幸甚

Wong Kong of the Independent Young
Chinese Magazine, who was recently
arrested at his office, No. 12 Pau
Kwong Lee(宝光里), in Chapei, by
the Woosung and Shanghai Constabulary
when over 10,000 copies of the magazine
were seized, was sentenced to two years'
imprisonment by Magistrate Lieu of the
Police Court, who also ordered that the
copies of the magazine seized be destroyed.

第 2 页
A. - 革命运动与国民会议。
什么是“革命”？这个问题在我的朋友 Mang Woo 撰写并刊登在《孤军》第三卷第二期的文章《改造中国的唯一途径》中已得到充分解答。以下是对“革命”的解释：
“某些人、组织或阶层的人，
‘此前在政治上从未有过任何影响，
‘夺取国家的政治权力，
‘并利用这一权力来重构
‘政治体制’。”
这些体制的重构是革命的结果，革命被定义为运用新力量重建中国的刺激因素。国民会议能否通过

pages.en:

of these new, consolidated forces, seize the political
power ? Can it employ these new forces as the incentive
to seize the political power ? If this is possible, then
the Citizens' Convention will develop into a citizens'
revolutionary body exclusively. If it be impossible the
convention will be useless as a revolutionary establishment.

Page 6.
4. The Citizens' Convention and the Citizens' Revolution.
The foregoing shows that people are of opinion that a
citizens convention can be established only after the citizens'
revolution has been successful and on that account they are
opposed to holding the convention at the present time. Neverthe-
less we must declare to the public that our object is not so
short-sighted as considered by others. In our efforts to establish
a citizens' convention we never will refuse to extend our support
to any task no matter how difficult it may be that could help
the cause of the revolution. Although the citizens' convention may
not be able to fulfil the wishes of the people or its functions
produce the desired effect, still it will gain publicity and make
an impression upon the minds of the people. Therefore to convoke the
convention is not without advantage. Why should we oppose it then?
Because the militarists are the only people of whom we are afraid,
as they will either exploit or spoil the convention. The conse-
quence would be that the convention will be powerless to resist
the militarists. Therefore before summoning the convention, the
foregoing points should be carefully studied. We must not conclude
that the convention would be advantageous to us only and for that
reason to have it established quickly, but we should be on our
guard lest others may use it in order to further their own desires.
I wish to enlighten the public as follows :-
1. The citizens' revolution is an urgent plan of to-day.
2. In order to carry out the citizens' revolution, first the
population must be consolidated so as to ensure sufficient

这些新的、巩固的力量，夺取政治权力？它能否利用这些新力量作为夺取政治权力的动力？如果这是可能的，那么国民会议将发展成为纯粹的公民革命机构。如果不可能，该会议作为革命机构将毫无用处。

第 6 页。
4. 国民会议与公民革命。
前述内容表明，人们认为只有在公民革命成功后才能建立国民会议，因此他们反对目前召开会议。然而，我们必须向公众声明，我们的目标并不像其他人认为的那样短视。在努力建立国民会议的过程中，我们绝不会拒绝支持任何有助于革命事业的任务，无论其多么困难。虽然国民会议可能无法满足人民的愿望或其职能无法产生预期的效果，但它仍能获得宣传效应并在人民心中留下印象。因此，召开会议并非没有好处。那我们为什么要反对呢？因为我们唯一害怕的是军阀，因为他们要么利用要么破坏会议。后果将是会议无力抵抗军阀。因此，在召集会议之前，应仔细研究上述几点。我们不应得出结论说会议仅对我们有利，因此要迅速建立，而应警惕他人可能利用它来进一步实现其自身欲望。我希望向公众阐明以下几点：
1. 公民革命是当今的紧迫计划。
2. 为了实施公民革命，首先必须团结人口，以确保足够的

pages.en:
- 3 -
strength.
3. The citizens' revolution should be a material problem
and not one of mere form.
4. The following must be accomplished to pave the way for the
citizens' revolution : (a) revolutionalize all established
bodies (b) organize the masses.
5. Wherever power goes, shape follows. Consequently the
citizens' convention whose duties are to solve national
problems should be summoned only after the success of the
revolution.

Page. 14.

Marxism and the State.
Mr. Kuo Mo Shih states as follows :
"The State may be established on two different systems -
the old style State and the modern State. The former is formed
by the capitalist class and is a weapon for plunder and
oppression. This kind of State represents a poisonous constitu-
tion for struggles. The modern State is proposed as opposing
the old style State. It is based on the system of public
property, and therefore can only be formed by the proletariat.
The aim of the modern State is to bring about permanent peace.
To unite the proletariats and establish a modern State on the
principles of public property with the object of securing human
emancipation both bodily and mentally, is undoubtedly Marx's
communism but may also be called the New Nationalism."
If my observations regarding Mr. Mo Shih's article are
correct, his idea may be briefly set as follows :-
Firstly Marxism does not renounce the State but
advocates New Nationalism.
Secondly Marx recognizes the State established by the
Proletariat and based on the principle of public property. In
other words the State is based on the people (the proletariat
and not the capitalist class).
pages.zh:
- 3 -
力量。
3. 公民革命应该是一个实质性问题，而不是形式问题。
4. 必须完成以下事项以为公民革命铺平道路：(a) 使所有既定机构革命化 (b) 组织群众。
5. 权力所在，形态随之。因此，职责为解决国家问题的国民会议，只应在革命成功后召开。

第 14 页。

马克思主义与国家。
郭沫若先生陈述如下：
“国家可以建立在两种不同的制度上——旧式国家和现代国家。前者由资产阶级形成，是掠夺和压迫的武器。这种国家代表了一种有毒的斗争体制。现代国家是作为反对旧式国家而提出的。它基于公有制体系，因此只能由无产阶级形成。现代国家的目标是带来永久和平。团结无产阶级，并在公有制原则基础上建立现代国家，以实现人类身心解放的目标，这无疑是马克思的共产主义，但也可以称为新民族主义。”
如果我对郭沫若先生文章的观察是正确的，他的观点可以简要概括如下：
首先，马克思主义并不放弃国家，而是倡导新民族主义。
其次，马克思承认由无产阶级建立并基于公有制原则的国家。换句话说，国家是基于人民（无产阶级而非资产阶级）的。

pages.en:
- 4 -
Page 17.
From the above it is apparent that the first
step towards the revolution of the working class, according
to Marx's opinion, is that the proletariat should seize
the political power and become the dispensing class.
This is what Marx, in his correspondence, called the
ascension to political power of the proletariat by revolution.
It is the transition period from the capitalistic to the
socialistic systems. During this transition period of
revolution, the proletariat should gradually seize the
power from the capitalist class and also the interests
pertaining to their productions and concentrate the
power of production in the State. Only by adopting absolute
measures in such seizures is it possible to put this scheme
into effect; no other means are effective. According to Marx,
the conditions in the transition period are : politically
the proletariat becomes the absolute power and economically
all means of production are centralized in the State. The ten
points enumerated in the declaration of the Communist Party
form the basis of its economic policy whereby the proletariat,
during the transition period, nationalize all means of
production through the medium of its political power.
pages.zh:
- 4 -
第 17 页。
从上述内容可以看出，根据马克思的观点，工人阶级革命的第一步是无产阶级应当夺取政治权力并成为统治阶级。这就是马克思在通信中所称的通过革命实现无产阶级的政治权力上升。这是从资本主义制度向社会主义制度的过渡时期。在这个革命过渡时期，无产阶级应逐渐从资产阶级手中夺取权力以及与生产相关的利益，并将生产权力集中在国家手中。只有采取绝对的没收措施，才能使这一方案生效；其他手段均无效。根据马克思的说法，过渡时期的条件是：政治上无产阶级成为绝对权力，经济上所有生产资料集中在国家手中。共产党宣言中列举的十点构成了其经济政策的基础，据此，无产阶级在过渡时期通过其政治权力将所有生产资料国有化。

第2页
A. - 革命运动与市民会议。
“革命”是什么意思？这个问题在我的朋友杭吾（音译）撰写并刊登在《孤军》第三卷第二期上的题为《改造中国的唯一途径》的文章中已得到充分解答。以下是对“革命”的解释：
“某些个人、组织或阶层，此前在政治上从未有过任何影响力，夺取了国家的政治权力，并利用这一权力来重构政治体制”。
这些体制的重构是革命的结果，被定义为利用新力量改造中国的刺激因素。市民会议能否通过

to seize the political power ? If this is possible, then

convention will be useless as a revolutionary establishment.

4. The Citizens' Convention and the Citizens' Revolution.
The foregoing shows that people are of opinion that a
citizens convention can be established only after the citizens'
revolution has been successful and on that account they are
opposed to holding the convention at the present time. Neverthe-
less we must declare to the public that our object is not so
short-sighted as considered by others. In our efforts to establish
a citizens' convention we never will refuse to extend our support
to any task no matter how difficult it may be that could help
the cause of the revolution. Although the citizens' convention may
not be able to fulfil the wishes of the people or its functions
produce the desired effect, still it will gain publicity and make
an impression upon the minds of the people. Therefore to convoke the
convention is not without advantage. Why should we oppose it then?
Because the militarists are the only people of whom we are afraid,
as they will either exploit or spoil the convention. The conse-
quence would be that the convention will be powerless to resist
the militarists. Therefore before summoning the convention, the
foregoing points should be carefully studied. We must not conclude
that the convention would be advantageous to us only and for that
reason to have it established quickly, but we should be on our
guard lest others may use it in order to further their own desires.
I wish to enlighten the public as follows :-
1. The citizens' revolution is an urgent plan of to-day.
2. In order to carry out the citizens' revolution, first the
population must be consolidated so as to ensure sufficient

第6页。
4. 市民会议与市民革命。
前述内容表明，人们认为只有在市民革命成功后才能建立市民会议，因此他们反对目前召开会议。然而，我们必须向公众声明，我们的目标并不像其他人所认为的那样短视。在努力建立市民会议的过程中，我们绝不会拒绝支持任何有助于革命事业的任务，无论其多么困难。虽然市民会议可能无法满足人民的愿望，或其职能无法产生预期的效果，但它仍将获得宣传效应，并在人民心中留下印象。因此，召集会议并非没有好处。那么我们为什么要反对它呢？因为我们唯一害怕的是军阀，因为他们要么利用会议，要么破坏会议。其后果将是会议无力抵抗军阀。因此，在召集会议之前，应仔细研究上述几点。我们绝不能断定会议仅对我们有利，并因此急于建立它，而应警惕他人可能利用它来进一步实现其自身欲望。我希望向公众阐明如下几点：
1. 市民革命是当今的紧迫计划。
2. 为了实行市民革命，首先必须团结民众，以确保足够的

pages.en:

strength.
3. The citizens' revolution should be a material problem
and not one of mere form.
4. The following must be accomplished to pave the way for the
citizens' revolution : (a) revolutionalize all established
bodies (b) organize the masses.
5. Wherever power goes shape follows. Consequently the
citizens' convention whose duties are to solve national
problems should be summoned only after the success of the
revolution.

Page. 14.
Marxism and the State.
Mr. Kuo Mo Shih states as follows :
"The State may be established on two different systems -
the old style State and the modern State. The former is formed
by the capitalist class and is a weapon for plunder and
oppression. This kind of State represents a poisonous constitu-
tion for struggles. The modern State is proposed as opposing
the old style State. It is based on the system of public
property, and therefore can only be formed by the proletariat.
The aim of the modern State is to bring about permanent peace.
To unite the proletariats and establish a modern State on the
principles of public property with the object of securing human
emancipation both bodily and mentally, is undoubtedly Marx's
communism but may also be called the New Nationalism."
If my observations regarding Mr. Mo Shih's article are
correct, his idea may be briefly set as follows :-
Firstly Marxism does not renounce the State but
advocates New Nationalism.
Secondly Marx recognizes the State established by the
Proletariat and based on the principle of public property. In
other words the State is based on the people (the proletariat
and not the capitalist class).

4. 必须完成以下事项以为市民革命铺平道路：(a) 使所有既定机构革命化 (b) 组织群众。

第14页。
马克思主义与国家。
郭沫若先生陈述如下：
“国家可以建立在两种不同的制度之上——旧式国家和现代国家。前者由资产阶级组成，是掠夺和压迫的武器。这种国家代表了一种有毒的斗争体制。提出现代国家是为了反对旧式国家。它基于公有制体系，因此只能由无产阶级组成。现代国家的目标是带来永久和平。团结无产者，并在公有制原则基础上建立现代国家，以实现人类身心解放的目标，这无疑是马克思的共产主义，但也可以称为新民族主义。”
如果我对郭沫若先生文章的观察是正确的，他的观点可以简要概括如下：
第一，马克思主义并不放弃国家，而是倡导新民族主义。
第二，马克思承认由无产阶级建立并基于公有制原则的国家。换句话说，国家是基于人民（即无产阶级，而非资产阶级）。

Page 17.
From the above it is apparent that the first
step towards the revolution of the working class, according
to Marx's opinion, is that the proletariat should seize
the political power and become the dispensing class.
This is what Marx, in his correspondence, called the
ascension to political power of the proletariat by revolution.
It is the transition period from the capitalistic to the
socialistic systems. During this transition period of
revolution, the proletariat should gradually seize the
power from the capitalist class and also the interests
pertaining to their productions and concentrate the
power of production in the State. Only by adopting absolute
measures in such seizures is it possible to put this scheme
into effect; no other means are effective. According to Marx,
the conditions in the transition period are : politically
the proletariat becomes the absolute power and economically
all means of production are centralized in the State. The ten
points enumerated in the declaration of the Communist Party
form the basis of its economic policy whereby the proletariat,
during the transition period, nationalize all means of
production through the medium of its political power.
